project.name: oxiguitar-wav-plugin
project.description: The OxiGuitar WAV export plugin: File → Export → WAV Audio. Converts guitar tablature score audio into WAV files at 16-bit, 24-bit, or 32-bit float, at 44.1 or 48 kHz.

nodes.name: CI Pipeline
nodes.summary: Main CI workflow: formatting, linting, testing on 6 platforms (Linux x86_64/ARM64, Windows x86_64/ARM64, macOS), license/advisory checks via cargo-deny, DCO sign-off verification, and a ci-success gate job.

nodes.name: Release Pipeline
nodes.summary: Reusable workflow for building and packaging the .oxp plugin file for each target system (Linux, Windows, macOS, x86_64 and ARM64). On PRs produces test builds; on v* tags creates draft releases.

nodes.name: Publish Pipeline
nodes.summary: Triggers on release published to notify package repositories and winget. Uses a reusable workflow from oxiguitar-packages with required secrets.

nodes.name: Changelog
nodes.summary: Project changelog following Keep a Changelog format with Semantic Versioning. Documents the first release (0.1.0) and the plugin's move to its own repository.

nodes.name: Claude Working Guide
nodes.summary: Standing rules for AI-assisted development: no forks, no telemetry, DCO sign-off, branch model (develop/main), git workflow conventions, and repository-specific policies.

nodes.name: Contributing Guide
nodes.summary: Contribution guidelines covering branch model (develop as default), squash-merge workflow, and DCO sign-off process. Links to the main OxiGuitar contributing guide.

nodes.name: Cargo Manifest
nodes.summary: Rust package manifest for oxiguitar-wav-plugin v0.1.0. Dependencies: oxiguitar-plugin (git tag v0.11.0), oxiguitar-plugin-test (dev). Features: oxp. Lints: deny unsafe, warn on clippy/doc warnings. Release profile: thin LTO, single codegen unit, strip symbols.

nodes.name: README
nodes.summary: Project overview: WAV export plugin for OxiGuitar guitar tablature software. Covers features (16/24/32-bit float, 44.1/48 kHz), installation, build instructions, history, and license (GPL-3.0-or-later).

nodes.name: Build Script
nodes.summary: Shell script that builds the .oxp plugin file for the current host system. Handles macOS universal binaries (lipo), Windows DLL, and Linux shared library output to dist/.

nodes.name: Clippy Configuration
nodes.summary: Clippy lint configuration: MSRV 1.99, allows unwrap/expect/panic/indexing in test code.

nodes.name: Cargo Deny Configuration
nodes.summary: Dependency license and security policy: allows GPL, MIT, Apache, BSD, ISC, Zlib, and other GPL-compatible licenses. Denies unknown registries and git sources. Targets 6 build platforms.

nodes.name: Plugin Manifest
nodes.summary: OxiGuitar plugin manifest: interface 1.4, id oxiguitar.wav, name 'WAV export', settings window enabled, single exporter (wav, audio, .wav extension).

nodes.name: Rustfmt Configuration
nodes.summary: Rustfmt settings: edition 2024, max width 100, field init shorthand.

nodes.name: Dependabot Configuration
nodes.summary: Weekly dependency updates for cargo and github-actions ecosystems. Ignores oxiguitar-* dependencies which are pinned by git tag (interface 1.4 frozen).

nodes.name: PR Template
nodes.summary: Pull request template: What changed, How to try it, Checklist (tests, docs, CREDITS, corpus, DCO sign-off).

nodes.name: DCO Check Script
nodes.summary: Shell script verifying DCO sign-off on all commits in a range. Skips Claude GitHub app and Dependabot commits. Used by CI dco job.

nodes.name: WAV Plugin Implementation
nodes.summary: Core implementation: WavPlugin (Plugin trait), Wav (AudioExporter trait), Window (settings UI via Tab trait), Format (WAV header generation with PCM/float support), Depth enum (16/24/32-bit), Export struct (dither with xorshift). Exports: Depth, Format, Wav, Window, WavPlugin, bytes, from_settings, header. 482 lines with 5 unit tests.

nodes.name: Contract Test Suite
nodes.summary: Integration test that builds the .oxp file and validates it through OxiGuitar's plugin host. Verifies the exporter wav passes all checks.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand what this project is: a WAV export plugin for OxiGuitar, a free guitar tablature and score viewer/editor/player. The plugin adds File → Export → WAV Audio functionality.

tour.title: Plugin Manifest
tour.description: Examine the plugin manifest to see how OxiGuitar discovers and configures this plugin: interface version, exporter ID, settings window, and file extension.

tour.title: Core Implementation
tour.description: Dive into the main source file: WavPlugin (the Plugin trait implementation), Wav (the AudioExporter that converts audio samples to WAV bytes), Window (the settings UI), Format (WAV header generation), Depth (bit depth enum), and Export (dithering state).

tour.title: Build System
tour.description: Review Cargo.toml for dependencies and build configuration, then build-oxp.sh for creating the distributable .oxp plugin file across platforms.

tour.title: Testing & Quality
tour.description: Explore the contract test that builds and validates the .oxp file through OxiGuitar's plugin host, the unit tests in lib.rs, and the CI pipeline that runs fmt, lint, test, deny, and DCO checks on 6 platforms.

tour.title: Release & Distribution
tour.description: Understand the release workflow (builds packages for all platforms, creates draft releases on v* tags) and the publish workflow (notifies package repositories and winget).
